source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΤΡΙΣΚΑΙΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ Ἔτι περὶ ἱερωσύνης. Ἱερέων μὲν δὴ πέρι καὶ Ἀαρὼν, ταυτὶ πρὸς ἡμῶν εἰρήσθω τέως. Χρῆναι δὲ οἶμαι προσενεγκεῖν οἷς ἔφην τὰ ἐκλελοιπέναι δοκοῦντα ἐπί γε τοῖς Λευΐταις τεθεσπισμένα. Ὧδε γὰρ ἔχοιτο ἀποχρῶν ὁ λόγος. {ΠΑΛΛ.} Οὐκοῦν ἴθι τοι, φράζε τε σαφῶς· διανοῇ γὰρ ὀρθῶς. {ΚΥΡ.} Τάξιν μὲν δὴ ταῖς ἱερουργίαις τὴν ἀρίστην ἐπιτιθεὶς, ὑποκαθίστησι τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ τὸ τάγμα τὸ Λευϊτικὸν, ἐν τοῖς Ἀριθμοῖς οὕτω λέγων· «Καὶ τοῖς Λευΐτ
pass_a_gloss: §1 dual gloss: ἐπιδέκατον / tenth; ἀφαίρεμα / taking-away … Pass A ≠ Pass B. Theme: Book 13 opens: still priesthood; Levites’ tithe-of-tithe to Aaron
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK THIRTEEN. Still concerning priesthood.

So then concerning priests and Aaron, let these things from us have been said for now. And I think one must bring near to what I said the things seeming to have been left out, at least the things legislated upon the Levites. For thus the word would have itself sufficient.
Palladius: So then go on, and speak clearly; for you think rightly.

Cyril: Setting then the best order upon the sacred-works, he sets under the high priest the Levitical rank, saying thus in Numbers: ‘And to the Levites you will speak, and you will say toward them: If you should take from the sons of Israel the tenth, which I have given you from them in a lot, you also will take away from it a taking-away to Lord, a tenth from the tenth, and your taking-aways will be reckoned for you as grain from a threshing-floor, and a taking-away from a winepress. Thus you also will take them away from all the taking-aways of Lord from all your tenths, as many as if you should take from the sons of Israel; and you will give from them a taking-away to Lord, to Aaron the priest from all your gifts you will take away a taking-away to Lord, or from all the firstfruits the sanctified from it. And you will say toward them: Whenever you take away the firstfruit from it, it will also be reckoned to the Levites as produce from a threshing-floor, and as produce from a winepress; and you will eat it in every place, you and your sons, and your houses, because this is a wage for you instead of your liturgies the in the tent of the witness; and you will not take sin through it, because if you should take away the firstfruit from it; and you will not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, in order that you may not’ (Numbers 18:26–32)
